text:
Three facts about lighthouses:
1. Lighthouses are towers or other structures that emit light from a system of lamps and lenses and are located on shore to serve as a aid to navigation for mariners.
2. The first modern lighthouse, the Pharos of Alexandria, was built in the 3rd century BC and was one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.
3. Many lighthouses are now automated and no longer require resident keepers, though some historic ones still maintain staff for tourism and preservation.
